quest.q1.title: First Light
quest.q1.summary: Your first solo sortie. A distress call from home, three errors in the core, and an order you cannot refuse. Start with what you hear.
quest.q2.title: Quiet Dock
quest.q2.summary: The station survives but cannot afford to pay. Decide what matters more: the dock's safety or its livelihood. Both answers are right — and both cost something.
quest.q3.title: Salt and Ash
quest.q3.summary: The caravan missed contact. The hold carries salt, and under the salt three crates someone will kill for. Find who profits.
quest.q4.title: Courier
quest.q4.summary: A container, two jumps, and a patrol on the route. Maev never asks what is inside. The question is whether you do.
quest.q5.title: Inspection
quest.q5.summary: A routine audit. Clause 12, subclause 4. Inspector Reyn never takes a bribe first — but she never refuses one either.
quest.q6.title: Echo in the Core
quest.q6.summary: SVET says «three errors». They are not errors: the core is tuned to something, and someone at the edge of the map answers.
quest.q7.title: First Verge
quest.q7.summary: An outpost on the frontier. Skar's fleet is coming for it. You have three ticks and three options: fight, talk, or trap.
quest.qside.title: A Rumour from the Tattered Pack
quest.qside.summary: A rumour from the Tattered Pack: the pirates keep a cache of someone else's cargo. Or it is a trap — rumours here are rarely free.
quest.qside.s1: Check the cache in the belt
quest.qside.s2: Decide what to do with the cargo
quest.qside.s3: Close the deal with the Pack
dlg.q1.n01: Dock Light-1, zero six forty. Flagship ready for departure. Three errors in the core. Not critical. For now.
dlg.q1.n02: Admiral, Command is on the line. Ceremony in forty seconds. Do not make them wait.
dlg.q1.c1: SVET is hiding something. You can still ask — or it is already too late.
dlg.q1.c1.a: I go now. The core can wait.
dlg.q1.c1.b: Three ticks for diagnostics. The station can wait.
dlg.q1.n04: Light-1 calling anyone! Repeat: anyone! Three of us... raiders in the belt... the airlock is failing...
dlg.q1.n05: Diagnostics: core deviation zero point four percent. Class norm is zero. I will remember this.
dlg.q1.c2: The debris belt. Two corvettes and a frigate. The frigate searches rather than raids. Decide whom to strike first.
dlg.q1.c2.a: The leader. Skar must not escape.
dlg.q1.c2.c: No shots. Scare them into withdrawing.
dlg.q1.n07: Engagement over. Losses: none. Salvage: two containers and a raider black box. The station answers.
dlg.q1.n08: You came. You actually came. Three wounded and two ticks of medicine left. What do we do?
dlg.q1.n10: You did better than I expected. That is not a compliment — it is an estimate.
dlg.q1.n11: You were three ticks late. The station lost a module. I will remember.
dlg.q1.c3: Report. Everything, as it is. Command is listening.
dlg.q1.c3.b: Hide it. The core is fine.
dlg.q1.n13: Logged in the watch journal: first sortie complete.
dlg.q1st.k1: You have entered the dock. It smells of soot and cooling metal. Medbay is to starboard.
dlg.q1st.k2: Three wounded. Two ticks of medicine. Dock repairs cost money. Decide.
dlg.q1st.k2.c: The cargo is a prize. So is the dock.
dlg.q1st.k3: I will remember. I do not know what this is paid with, but I will remember.
dlg.q1st.k4: Eight hundred. Standard rate. No hard feelings?
dlg.q1st.k5: So you are one of them too. We will manage. Without you. Next time, do not answer the call.
dlg.q1sv.v1: Engagement over. Shields at nine percent, hull nominal. You are unharmed.
dlg.q1sv.v2: I recorded your course. It diverged from the order by two point three seconds. Not critical. For now.
dlg.q1sv.v3: SVET keeps its own watch: three errors in the core, one in the admiral.

quest.q2.fx.escort: You struck the escorts first: the military appreciated the manoeuvre
dlg.camp.epi.n01: Chronometer: cycle seven thousand two hundred. Choir resonance amplitude dropped below universal cosmic background.
dlg.camp.epi.n02: Tactical grid clear. Forty percent of flagship armor plate scorched to framework, but structural integrity holds.
dlg.camp.epi.c1: Disposition of the surviving battle fleets:
dlg.camp.epi.c1.a: Dismantle weapon bays and convert hulls to civilian relief transports.
dlg.camp.epi.c1.b: Maintain permanent combat battle-stations along the frontier rim.
dlg.camp.epi.n04: Casualty logs closed. For the first time in three operational years, there are no open distress beacons.
dlg.camp.epi.n05: Station Light-1 reopens commercial airlocks. The fourteen survivors welcome the first peacetime convoy.
dlg.camp.epi.c2: How shall history record the conduct of this war?
dlg.camp.epi.c2.a: Publish complete unredacted transcripts of all betrayals and losses.
dlg.camp.epi.c2.b: Author a unified myth of flawless heroism to preserve stability.
dlg.camp.epi.n07: AI query: shall the three flagship core errors be logged as bugs or as the voice of predecessors?
dlg.camp.epi.n09: Mission accomplished, Admiral. You have earned the right to step ashore.
dlg.camp.epi.chronicle: Epilogue: Campaign concluded. Historic legacy of the war sealed into record.
dlg.q1.fx.going_now: You go at once: the station is intact, Kira-7 will remember
dlg.q1.fx.diagnose: Three ticks of diagnostics: the station loses a module, the fight is easier
dlg.q1.fx.leader: Strike the leader: Skar escapes, the corvettes surrender
dlg.q1.fx.escort: Strike the escorts: Skar is wounded, the leader escapes
dlg.q1.fx.noshots: No shots: less salvage, more survivors
dlg.q1.fx.honest: Honest report: the archive opens, the investigation is shorter
dlg.q1.fx.hide: Hidden core: the investigation costs more, Null-Five is needed
dlg.q1.fx.teira: Only to Teira: trust grows, the investigation is longer
dlg.q1st.fx.repair: Repairs on your account: −1200 credits, Kira owes you
dlg.q1st.fx.fee: Standard fee: +800 credits, relations stay neutral
dlg.q1st.fx.salvage: Cargo as prize: +2400 credits, the station shuts you out
dlg.camp.act2_c.n01: Forty-two hulls lost on the line. We cannot hold the front if every sector hoards its ships in deep hangars.
dlg.camp.act2_c.n02: The colonial worlds fear centralization far more than the Choir. One wrong move, and the Hegemon cuts our fuel lines.
dlg.camp.act2_c.c1: How shall we distribute fleet command after this first crisis?
dlg.camp.act2_c.c1.a: Subordinate all task forces to flagship First Light. A single fist.
dlg.camp.act2_c.c1.b: Delegate defensive patrol authority to local colonial flotillas.
dlg.camp.act2_c.fx.centralize: Fleet centralized under unified command; Kain's trust increases.
dlg.camp.act2_c.fx.delegate: Colonial autonomy preserved; Selena's trust increases.
dlg.camp.act2_c.n04: Fleet response telemetry recomputed. Reaction time across strike wings reduced by twenty-four percent.
dlg.camp.act2_c.n05: Light-1 hub routing incoming emergency packets: fourteen sectors demand audience. Airllocks crowded, protocol breached.
dlg.camp.act2_c.c2: When do we convene the Grand System Council?
dlg.camp.act2_c.c2.a: Immediately, while the crisis is raw. No secrets behind closed doors.
dlg.camp.act2_c.c2.b: Delay until the defensive rim stabilizes. Borders outrank speeches.
dlg.camp.act2_c.fx.council_now: Council convened immediately; early legislative debates opened.
dlg.camp.act2_c.n07: I do not care about protocol halls. I need to know: if I order an offensive strike, will you guard my flanks?
dlg.camp.act2_c.c3: What forms the foundation of our doctrine?
dlg.camp.act2_c.c3.a: Direct reliance on Admiral Kain and uncompromising fleet discipline.
dlg.camp.act2_c.c3.b: Institutional checks and broad civil Council consensus.
dlg.camp.act2_c.fx.trust_admiral: Kain's military authority confirmed by personal decree.
dlg.camp.act2_c.fx.trust_council: Decisions anchored to civil council protocols and diplomacy.
dlg.camp.act2_c.n09: Warships can be fabricated in six months. Humans pulled from melted pods cannot be replaced by any shipyard.
dlg.camp.act2_c.n10: Log entry stored. Core anomaly number two shifted frequency by three hertz.
dlg.camp.act2_c.chronicle: Act II: Post-crisis Council concluded. Frontline command hierarchy formalized.
dlg.camp.act3_t.n01: Telemetry from the Rift trench is decoded. The Ansars were not constructing a weapon of war. It is a muffler.
dlg.camp.act3_t.n02: Choir acoustic frequency matches the distress beacon of the Third Expedition. Probability of coincidence: zero point six percent.
dlg.camp.act3_t.c1: What do we do with the truth about the Builders and the Rift?
dlg.camp.act3_t.c1.a: Disclose the archives to all worlds. The galaxy deserves the truth.
dlg.camp.act3_t.c1.b: Classify the data. Mass panic on the frontier will break us before the Choir.
dlg.camp.act3_t.c1.c: Weaponize the resonance frequency as psychological deterrence.
dlg.camp.act3_t.fx.reveal: Builder truth published; path to sealing the Rift opened.
dlg.camp.act3_t.fx.hide: Archives classified; authority preserved within command staff.
dlg.camp.act3_t.fx.use: Resonance converted into deterrence; path of Whisper opened.
dlg.camp.act3_t.n04: If financial markets learn the Rift triggers on engine volume, interstellar trade collapses in under thirty minutes.
dlg.camp.act3_t.n05: The Ansar relic sits in our hangar. It hums in tandem with First Light's core. Who holds the right to direct it?
dlg.camp.act3_t.c2.a: Integrate into the flagship power grid to reinforce heavy batteries.
dlg.camp.act3_t.c2.b: Transfer to Teira's independent research council for study.
dlg.camp.act3_t.c2.c: Contain in shielded cold-storage and dampen acoustic bleed.
dlg.camp.act3_t.fx.relic_empire: Relic fused with ship core; курс set toward technological dominance.
dlg.camp.act3_t.fx.relic_returned: Relic entrusted to researchers; conscience trust preserved.
dlg.camp.act3_t.fx.relic_burned: Relic neutralized; background resonance baseline reduced.
dlg.camp.act3_t.n07: Light-1 detects catastrophic gravitational shear. The Choir vanguard translated out of hyper-transit at marker thirteen.
dlg.camp.act3_t.c3.a: Sortie immediately on intercept vector. Meet them at the threshold.
dlg.camp.act3_t.c3.b: Anchor formation around the megastructure. Not one step back.
dlg.camp.act3_t.fx.march_now: Fleet advances into counter-assault; invasion mission unlocked.
dlg.camp.act3_t.fx.fortify: Defensive perimeter consolidated; megastructure mission unlocked.
dlg.camp.act3_t.n09: They hear us. Every salvo from our kinetic batteries sounds to them like a formal duel challenge.
dlg.camp.act3_t.n10: Harmonic core displacement registered. Three errors stabilized into a coherent signal.
dlg.camp.act3_t.chronicle: Act III: Builder truth uncovered. The Choir launches full sector offensive.
dlg.camp.act4_l.n01: Ansar engine schematic decoded. Theoretical output exceeds Third Flotilla's total grid capacity by factor of forty.
dlg.camp.act4_l.n02: Syndicate envoys are holding on a scrambled line. They offer to erase our entire war debt for blueprint access.
dlg.camp.act4_l.c1: Disposition of the Ansar engine legacy:
dlg.camp.act4_l.c1.a: Ignite the engine at full yield. We require overwhelming force.
dlg.camp.act4_l.c1.b: Seal the drive in cryo-stasis. This power is inherently suicidal.
dlg.camp.act4_l.c1.c: Trade schematics to the Syndicate in exchange for complete war funding.
dlg.camp.act4_l.fx.use_engine: Engine ignited; Titan mission unlocked; Ascension hinted.
dlg.camp.act4_l.fx.seal_engine: Legacy placed in stasis; Seal ending hinted.
dlg.camp.act4_l.n04: Crews see bulkheads glowing with induced harmonic discharge. Whispers spread that we are becoming monsters.
dlg.camp.act4_l.n05: Six hundred technicians signed panic incident reports today. We cannot maintain radio silence on this much longer.
dlg.camp.act4_l.c2: What statement do we issue to the fleet?
dlg.camp.act4_l.c2.a: Full honest brief: the engine lures the Choir, but grants victory.
dlg.camp.act4_l.c2.b: Fabricate cover story attributing the drive to home-world research.
dlg.camp.act4_l.fx.fleet_truth: Fleet briefed on actual stakes; crew and Teira's trust solidified.
dlg.camp.act4_l.fx.fleet_lie: Truth shielded by cover story; immediate panic averted.
dlg.camp.act4_l.n07: Light-1 intercepted an encrypted tight-beam transmission leaving our ship. Foreign office diplomatic key.
dlg.camp.act4_l.n08: Decryption header traces to Counselor Selena Varr's terminal. Recipient is Outcast warlord Khar-An.
dlg.camp.act4_l.n09: Treason on the bridge. Security detachments are sealing the diplomatic suite.
dlg.camp.act4_l.chronicle: Act IV: Ansar engine deployed. Counselor's unauthorized back-channel exposed.
dlg.camp.act4_b.n01: I make no excuses, Admiral. I handed over routing vectors for three convoys to buy you four months to finish the Titan.
dlg.camp.act4_b.n02: Four months bought with forty thousand colonial lives on Frontier-4. You traded their coordinates like scrap metal.
dlg.camp.act4_b.n03: Naval field courts need neither debate nor speeches. The execution order is drafted for your signature.
dlg.camp.act4_b.c1.a: Selena's: the calculus was horrific, but spared the core empire collapse.
dlg.camp.act4_b.c1.b: Teira's: betrayal remains betrayal, no strategic excuse holds.
dlg.camp.act4_b.fx.believe_selena: Selena's cold calculus accepted; Teira and Kain alienated.
dlg.camp.act4_b.fx.believe_teira: Teira's moral stance affirmed; Selena awaits sentencing.
dlg.camp.act4_b.n05: Casualty audit: forty-one thousand two hundred confirmed dead. The delay permitted the secondary shield line to come online.
dlg.camp.act4_b.n06: Pass sentence, Admiral. But do not pretend your hands stayed cleaner than mine while ordering orbital strikes.
dlg.camp.act4_b.c2.a: Pardon into active duties under constant counter-intel surveillance.
dlg.camp.act4_b.c2.b: Summary execution on the bridge under emergency martial code.
dlg.camp.act4_b.c2.c: Strip all commissions and exile to an abandoned rim listening post.
dlg.camp.act4_b.fx.forgive: Selena pardoned; officer corps outraged by leniency.
dlg.camp.act4_b.fx.execute: Selena executed; discipline written in blood; Ironman hinted.
dlg.camp.act4_b.fx.exile: Selena exiled into the void; Exile ending hinted.
dlg.camp.act4_b.n08: Station Light-1 awaits official broadcast. Rumors of command schisms are paralyzing frontier supply runs.
dlg.camp.act4_b.c3: Final address to the fleet garrisons:
dlg.camp.act4_b.c3.a: 'The law is absolute, binding every soul who wears our uniform.'
dlg.camp.act4_b.c3.b: 'Guns train outward. All internal vendettas yield to victory.'
dlg.camp.act4_b.fx.verdict_law: Doctrine grounded in strict rule of law and naval discipline.
dlg.camp.act4_b.fx.verdict_unity: Doctrine focused on the outer enemy and fleet cohesion.
dlg.camp.act4_b.n10: Channel closed. Bridge internal security protocols set to code red.
dlg.camp.act4_b.chronicle: Act IV: Sentence passed upon Selena Varr. Internal leadership crisis resolved.
dlg.camp.fin_d.n01: Flagship entered full resonance basin. Core displacement and Rift harmonics are completely in phase.
dlg.camp.fin_d.n02: We stand before the final boundary. The Rift awaits the command that will decide if this galaxy falls silent forever.
dlg.camp.fin_d.c1: What does the Builders' Rift represent to us?
dlg.camp.fin_d.c1.a: A gateway to the next plane of existence, transcending physical war.
dlg.camp.fin_d.c1.b: An unmatched weapon of supremacy, rightful prize of our strength.
dlg.camp.fin_d.c1.c: A mass grave and eternal monument to the terrible price of loud noise.
dlg.camp.fin_d.fx.rift_door: Rift declared a threshold; Ascension ending hinted.
dlg.camp.fin_d.fx.rift_weapon: Rift declared a weapon of state; Control ending hinted.
dlg.camp.fin_d.fx.rift_grave: Rift recognized as tragedy; Seal ending hinted.
dlg.camp.fin_d.n04: The Choir fleet encloses the sector in a unbroken wall of resonance. Kinetic arrays loaded. Awaiting final command.
dlg.camp.fin_d.n05: All interstellar channels overloaded. Fourteen worlds are listening to the harmonic tone of our drive core.
dlg.camp.fin_d.c2: Final command directive of First Light:
dlg.camp.fin_d.c2.a: Seal the Rift permanently. Turn the five Ansar keys to silence.
dlg.camp.fin_d.c2.b: Subjugate the Rift resonance beneath the supreme will of our fleet.
dlg.camp.fin_d.c2.c: Release the frequency across all colonial worlds. End monopoly.
dlg.camp.fin_d.c2.d: Broadcast the Whisper harmonic: cease all acoustic projection.
dlg.camp.fin_d.fx.final_whisper: Whisper harmonic broadcast; secret ending_whisper hinted.
dlg.camp.fin_d.n07: Dispatcher Kira-7 on priority relay: colonial orbits holding, but planetary thermal sinks are boiling away.
dlg.camp.fin_d.c3: To whom do you pledge the final debt of this war?
dlg.camp.fin_d.c3.a: To the fleet and the void crews who died in burning armor for us.
dlg.camp.fin_d.c3.b: To the worlds and civilian families waiting in bunker shelters.
dlg.camp.fin_d.c3.c: To truth and pure memory that will outlive every passing empire.
dlg.camp.fin_d.fx.price_fleet: Final debt dedicated to the navy and fallen void fighters.
dlg.camp.fin_d.fx.price_worlds: Final debt dedicated to civilian colonies and survivors.
dlg.camp.fin_d.fx.price_knowledge: Final debt dedicated to the archive of objective truth.
dlg.camp.fin_d.n09: Order received and confirmed. Task force holds battle stations until reactor burnout.
dlg.camp.fin_d.n10: May the archives at least record what this silence cost us.
dlg.camp.fin_d.n11: Initiating terminal sequence. SVET concludes escort telemetry routine.
dlg.camp.fin_d.chronicle: Act V: Threshold breached. Ultimate outcome of the galactic war determined.
dlg.camp.epi.fx.transports: Fleet demilitarized into relief and reconstruction vessels.
dlg.camp.epi.fx.garrison: Fleet stands permanent guard over the sector perimeter.
dlg.camp.epi.fx.story_truth: Uncensored records opened to public history; hard truth kept.
dlg.camp.epi.fx.story_myth: Heroic legend crafted to bind shattered frontier worlds.
dlg.camp.epi.c3.a: Warning: 'Silence is the sole law of survival in the deep dark.'
dlg.camp.epi.c3.b: Gift: 'We have learned to live alongside our own voice.'
dlg.camp.epi.fx.legacy_warning: Warning of silence carved into every navigation beacon.
dlg.camp.epi.fx.legacy_gift: Survival wisdom bequeathed to posterity as gift of freedom.
dlg.camp.epi.n10: Bridge log finalized. Data pushed to permanent archive. First Light enters deep sleep.
dlg.camp.act3_t.c1.d: Reveal the truth together with the fleet.
dlg.camp.act3_t.fx.reveal_fleet: Truth revealed with the centralised fleet behind you
dlg.camp.act3_t.c1.e: Hide the truth while keeping the colonial patrols.
dlg.camp.act3_t.fx.hide_patrol: Truth hidden: patrols hold, archives stay silent
dlg.camp.act3_t.c2.d: Hand the relic to the Council of Systems.
dlg.camp.act3_t.fx.relic_council: The relic goes to the Council: allies gain a voice
dlg.camp.act3_t.c3.c: March to intercept on the Council's decision.
dlg.camp.act3_t.fx.march_council: The Council sanctioned the march: army and colonies together
dlg.camp.act4_l.c1.d: Seal the engine, following the Rift's truth.
dlg.camp.act4_l.fx.seal_truth: Engine sealed by the truth: the fleet understands the price
dlg.camp.act4_l.c1.e: Turn the engine into a Whisper resonance.
dlg.camp.act4_l.fx.use_whisper: Engine tuned to the Whisper: the path to the mystery opens
dlg.camp.act4_l.c2.c: Tell the fleet the truth through Ansari hands.
dlg.camp.act4_l.fx.fleet_ansari: The fleet hears the truth from the Ansari: trust grows
dlg.camp.act4_b.c1.c: Trust the engine's calculus, not morality.
dlg.camp.act4_b.fx.believe_engine: You believed Selena for the engine's sake: the fleet is wary
dlg.camp.act4_b.c2.d: Forgive Selena for the fleet's truth.
dlg.camp.act4_b.fx.forgive_truth: The fleet's truth outweighed the verdict: Teira stays
dlg.camp.act4_b.c3.c: Syndicate law: the debt matters more than the verdict.
dlg.camp.act4_b.fx.verdict_syndicate: A Syndicate verdict: credits instead of blood
dlg.camp.fin_d.c1.d: The Rift is a truth you cannot unsee.
dlg.camp.fin_d.fx.rift_truth: The Rift as truth: the galaxy learns the price
dlg.camp.fin_d.c2.e: Control the Rift by the engine's might.
dlg.camp.fin_d.fx.final_control_engine: Control through the engine: power without monopoly
dlg.camp.fin_d.c2.f: Hand the Rift to the Syndicate as an asset.
dlg.camp.fin_d.fx.final_syndicate: The Rift sold: the galaxy now has a price
dlg.camp.fin_d.c2.g: Seal the Rift quietly, by the truth.
dlg.camp.fin_d.fx.final_seal_quiet: A quiet seal: no one learns the price
dlg.camp.fin_d.fx.price_law: Final debt to the Law: order outlives the name
dlg.camp.fin_d.fx.price_selena: Final debt to Selena: calculation becomes memory
dlg.camp.epi.fx.exiled: The exiled remember: the story has an edge of the map
dlg.camp.epi.fx.story_selena: Selena's story: the price is named, the name forgotten
dlg.camp.epi.fx.story_teira: Teira's story: the names are written in the Book of Memory
dlg.camp.epi.fx.legacy_fleet: The fleet's debt is paid: discipline remains
dlg.camp.epi.fx.legacy_worlds: The worlds' debt is paid: life remains
dlg.camp.epi.fx.legacy_knowledge: Knowledge's debt is paid: the archives remain
dlg.camp.act0_r.n01: Bridge, this is Light-1! They were not looting the depots — they were hunting the ancients' power node in the station's foundation.
dlg.camp.act0_r.n02: The marking reads «an-sari». My brother studied such script before his cruiser vanished at the Far Verge. This is no machine part. It is a resonance tuning fork.
dlg.camp.act0_r.c1: What do we do with the relic?
dlg.camp.act0_r.c1.a: Study it. Let SVET and the science team take it apart layer by layer.
dlg.camp.act0_r.fx.study: The relic is studied: science grows, the silence is broken
dlg.camp.act0_r.c1.b: Seal it. Do not touch what sings.
dlg.camp.act0_r.fx.seal: The relic is sealed: the fleet approves, Teira is wary
dlg.camp.act0_r.c1.c: Give it to Teira. She knows the language better than we do.
dlg.camp.act0_r.fx.give: The relic is with Teira: trust grows, the path to the Ansari opens
dlg.camp.act0_r.n04: Resonance recorded. Signal level matches three flagship cores. Recommendation: do not answer aloud.
dlg.camp.act0_r.c2: The voice from the relic is waiting. What will the flagship answer?
dlg.camp.act0_r.c2.a: Stay silent. Let them think we are not here.
dlg.camp.act0_r.fx.silence: The answer is silence: Kira-7 smiles for the first time
dlg.camp.act0_r.c2.b: Answer. We did not come here to hide.
dlg.camp.act0_r.fx.answer: The answer is given: the scholars recorded the harmonic
dlg.camp.act0_r.c2.c: Jam it. We do not need it singing in our heads.
dlg.camp.act0_r.fx.mute: The signal is jammed: the fleet is calm, Teira frowns
dlg.camp.act0_r.n06: My brother listened to such tuning forks. He said they do not call — they test.
dlg.camp.act0_r.n07: Record saved. Resonance stable. I will not ask what you heard.
dlg.camp.act0_r.n08: The «An-Sari» relic is aboard: first contact made
dlg.camp.act0_r.n09: Station Light-1 holds. Thank you, Admiral.
dlg.camp.act0_r.chronicle: Act 0: the Ansari relic and the first voice of the Choir recorded
dlg.camp.act1_h.n01: Greetings, commander of a wandering fleet. The Hegemony cannot ignore a Builders' relic in an untamed sector.
dlg.camp.act1_h.n02: Vassalage on a platter. They offer to make us the metropolis's hounds for a barrel of deuterium.
dlg.camp.act1_h.c1.a: Accept the recognition pact. The frontier must eat.
dlg.camp.act1_h.fx.vassal: The pact is signed: credits and supplies, but gendarmes on the bases
dlg.camp.act1_h.c1.b: Throw the commissioner out. The frontier will be free.
dlg.camp.act1_h.fx.reject: The pact is rejected: embargo and blockade, but the banner of freedom
dlg.camp.act1_h.n04: You will regret this, commander. The Hegemony knows how to wait.
dlg.camp.act1_h.n05: We have just chosen what we pay with: pride or bread.
dlg.camp.act1_h.c2: Whom do you trust with the frontier's answer?
dlg.camp.act1_h.c2.a: Kane. The fleet understands only orders.
dlg.camp.act1_h.fx.trust_kane: Kane owns the answer: the fleet stands united
dlg.camp.act1_h.c2.b: Selena. She knows how to talk to the metropolis.
dlg.camp.act1_h.fx.trust_selena: Selena owns the answer: negotiations continue
dlg.camp.act1_h.c2.c: Neither. A compromise is an answer too.
dlg.camp.act1_h.fx.compromise: Compromise accepted: traders approve, everyone stays wary
dlg.camp.act1_h.n07: You made a choice, Admiral. I will remember you did not hide.
dlg.camp.act1_h.n08: Embargo in effect. Alloy shortage projection: 18%.
dlg.camp.act1_h.n10: The frontier will remember this day. As a beginning — or as a price.
dlg.camp.act1_h.chronicle: Act I: the answer to the Hegemony and the trust behind it recorded
dlg.camp.act2_c.out.centralize: Fleet centralized under unified command; Kain's trust increases.
dlg.camp.act2_c.out.delegate: Colonial autonomy preserved; Selena's trust increases.
dlg.camp.act2_c.out.council_now: Council convened immediately; early legislative debates opened.
dlg.camp.act2_c.out.trust_admiral: Kain's military authority confirmed by personal decree.
dlg.camp.act2_c.out.trust_council: Decisions anchored to civil council protocols and diplomacy.
dlg.camp.act3_t.out.reveal: Builder truth published; path to sealing the Rift opened.
dlg.camp.act3_t.out.hide: Archives classified; authority preserved within command staff.
dlg.camp.act3_t.out.use: Resonance converted into deterrence; path of Whisper opened.
dlg.camp.act3_t.out.relic_empire: Relic fused with ship core; курс set toward technological dominance.
dlg.camp.act3_t.out.relic_returned: Relic entrusted to researchers; conscience trust preserved.
dlg.camp.act3_t.out.relic_burned: Relic neutralized; background resonance baseline reduced.
dlg.camp.act3_t.out.march_now: Fleet advances into counter-assault; invasion mission unlocked.
dlg.camp.act3_t.out.fortify: Defensive perimeter consolidated; megastructure mission unlocked.
dlg.camp.act4_l.out.use_engine: Engine ignited; Titan mission unlocked; Ascension hinted.
dlg.camp.act4_l.out.seal_engine: Legacy placed in stasis; Seal ending hinted.
dlg.camp.act4_l.out.fleet_truth: Fleet briefed on actual stakes; crew and Teira's trust solidified.
dlg.camp.act4_l.out.fleet_lie: Truth shielded by cover story; immediate panic averted.
dlg.camp.act4_b.out.believe_selena: Selena's cold calculus accepted; Teira and Kain alienated.
dlg.camp.act4_b.out.believe_teira: Teira's moral stance affirmed; Selena awaits sentencing.
dlg.camp.act4_b.out.forgive: Selena pardoned; officer corps outraged by leniency.
dlg.camp.act4_b.out.execute: Selena executed; discipline written in blood; Ironman hinted.
dlg.camp.act4_b.out.exile: Selena exiled into the void; Exile ending hinted.
dlg.camp.act4_b.out.verdict_law: Doctrine grounded in strict rule of law and naval discipline.
dlg.camp.act4_b.out.verdict_unity: Doctrine focused on the outer enemy and fleet cohesion.
dlg.camp.fin_d.out.rift_door: Rift declared a threshold; Ascension ending hinted.
dlg.camp.fin_d.out.rift_weapon: Rift declared a weapon of state; Control ending hinted.
dlg.camp.fin_d.out.rift_grave: Rift recognized as tragedy; Seal ending hinted.
dlg.camp.fin_d.out.final_whisper: Whisper harmonic broadcast; secret ending_whisper hinted.
dlg.camp.fin_d.out.price_fleet: Final debt dedicated to the navy and fallen void fighters.
dlg.camp.fin_d.out.price_worlds: Final debt dedicated to civilian colonies and survivors.
dlg.camp.fin_d.out.price_knowledge: Final debt dedicated to the archive of objective truth.
dlg.camp.teira_a.n01: Late watch. The wardroom is dim, lit only by a rotating projection of the Relic Reach constellation.
dlg.camp.teira_a.n02: My brother, Yuli. Four years older than me. Before leaving for the Rift he gave me his tag and said: «There is no emptiness ahead, Teira. Something breathes there».
dlg.camp.teira_a.c1: Teira waits for an answer. What will you promise her?
dlg.camp.teira_a.c1.a: No negotiations with the harmonic. I promise.
dlg.camp.teira_a.fx.promise: Teira receives the promise: silence as law
dlg.camp.teira_a.c1.b: I promise the truth. Even if it is unbearable.
dlg.camp.teira_a.fx.truth: Teira receives truth instead of a promise: trust grows
dlg.camp.teira_a.c1.c: I do not give promises I cannot keep.
dlg.camp.teira_a.fx.refuse: Teira accepts the refusal: the witness remains a witness
dlg.camp.teira_a.n04: She is silent for a long time, looking at the tag in her palm. Then she nods, as if recording it in the log.
dlg.camp.teira_a.n05: The flagship's noise recordings contain a voice fragment matching Yuli's profile. Probability of a phantom: 92%.
dlg.camp.teira_a.c2: What do we do with the recording of her brother's voice?
dlg.camp.teira_a.c2.a: Keep it in Teira's personal archive.
dlg.camp.teira_a.fx.keep: The recording is with Teira: she smiles for the first time
dlg.camp.teira_a.c2.b: Give it to science: a voice is data too.
dlg.camp.teira_a.fx.archive: The recording is archived: science gets a Choir fragment
dlg.camp.teira_a.c2.c: Erase it. Let him stay alive in memory.
dlg.camp.teira_a.fx.erase: The recording is erased: Teira neither thanks you nor argues
dlg.camp.teira_a.n07: The record is closed. The voice profile is stored in a secure contour.
dlg.camp.teira_a.n08: Thank you, Admiral. I will come with you. Someone has to count the losses.
dlg.camp.teira_a.n09: Teira's arc: the promise and Yuli's voice recording recorded
dlg.camp.teira_a.n10: She puts the tag back in her pocket — not as a relic, but as a debt.
dlg.camp.teira_a.n11: Recommendation: do not call it a miracle. It is the witness's work.
dlg.camp.kira_a.n01: The Admiral arrives at Light-1 for inspection. The station runs on fumes. A field hospital fills the hydroponics bay.
dlg.camp.kira_a.n02: Fourteen sectors sent 300% over the refugee norm. Water recycling is failing. My relays melt every four hours.
dlg.camp.kira_a.c1: Who gets the filters: the station or the fleet?
dlg.camp.kira_a.c1.a: The station. The people in the rear should not drink condensate.
dlg.camp.kira_a.fx.station: Filters go to the station: Kira-7 owes you, Act V militia is stronger
dlg.camp.kira_a.c1.b: The fleet. Sailors under radiation are the price of victory.
dlg.camp.kira_a.fx.fleet: Filters go to the fleet: ships stay in service, the station is furious
dlg.camp.kira_a.n04: She records the decision without emotion — only consumption figures and the names of those who will drink condensate.
dlg.camp.kira_a.n05: Projection: without filters the station holds forty-eight hours. Second projection: the fleet loses two reactors.
dlg.camp.kira_a.c2: How do we compensate the losing side?
dlg.camp.kira_a.c2.a: Pay the station for emergency repairs.
dlg.camp.kira_a.fx.comp_civil: The station receives compensation: Kira-7 remembers
dlg.camp.kira_a.c2.b: Promise the fleet new filters next cycle.
dlg.camp.kira_a.fx.comp_fleet: The fleet receives a promise: the engineers hold on
dlg.camp.kira_a.fx.comp_none: No compensation: both sides will remember
dlg.camp.kira_a.n07: Kira-7 looks up: «I remembered you. All fourteen remembered».
dlg.camp.kira_a.n08: Decision recorded. The station enters rationing mode.
dlg.camp.kira_a.n09: Kira-7's arc: the station's debt and the filter distribution recorded
dlg.camp.kira_a.n10: She returns to the soldering iron. The work does not wait.
dlg.camp.teira_a.chronicle: Teira's arc: the promise and Yuli's voice recording recorded
dlg.camp.kira_a.chronicle: Kira-7's arc: the station's debt and the filter distribution recorded
